status: DRY-RUN — no mutation until Gate F approval
shape: Norns pattern on Operations: Objective field 'improve-claude-plugins' (existing, reused) -> 12 objective parent issues -> 126 leaf sub-issues

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Ship run-start intent envelope for lifecycle autonomy
phase1_objective_parents.mission: One committed intent envelope at run start makes autonomy, spend, and ceremony posture explicit, durable, and consumed by every gate.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Make tier+effort a first-class priced resolvable lever
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Tier and effort become authored, resolved, priced, and enforced fields with one palette, one resolver, and halt-not-degrade guarantees.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Stand up the external-engine offload lane
phase1_objective_parents.mission: External engines become a registry-driven, receipt-proven, economically-guarded advisory lane that can never silently substitute or gatekeep.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Govern fleet concurrency and reclaim leaked resources
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Concurrency becomes declared policy with leases, retry, settlement, and liveness so nothing leaks, dies silently, or sums past the cap.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Automate the ship ceremony end-to-end
phase1_objective_parents.mission: One resumable guarded ship primitive replaces the manual commit-to-cleanup ritual, with hazard preflight, undo, and teardown reconciliation.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Make cache economics an engineered, measured win
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Prompt-cache reuse becomes designed, scheduled, and benchmarked instead of accidental: stable prefixes, residency scheduling, and proven savings.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Build the fleet telemetry and ledger substrate
phase1_objective_parents.mission: One append-only run-fact ledger under all telemetry: spend, cache, evidence, delegation, and the reports that make claims falsifiable.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Enforce context-library standards at authoring time
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Standards become machine-readable contracts enforced at authoring and CI time, with authority resolution and enforcement-coverage gates.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Establish single-source-of-truth for shared primitives
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Shared vocabularies, contracts, and vendored artifacts get one source, one parity registry, and guarded propagation instead of hand copies.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Gate fleet integrity (agent files, prompts, release surfaces)
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Agent files, prompts, tests, CI parity, and release surfaces are linted, audited, and generated so drift cannot land silently.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Make the backlog and lifecycle self-improving
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Mining, promotion, liveness tripwires, and admission control close the loop from finished work back into a healthier backlog.

phase1_objective_parents.title: objective: Expand saga+deploy capability breadth (misc/quick-wins)
phase1_objective_parents.mission: Capability-breadth extensions and grooming quick wins that ride on the wave-1/2 substrates.
